market_summary: Across the London morning session, all six tracked assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100, XAGUSD, BTCUSD) are consolidating inside their respective session Value Areas, closely tethered to Point of Control (POC) fair-value magnets. Momentum is subdued across the board, with no asset triggering RVOL > 2.0 yellow volume confirmation. GBPUSD attempted an expansion above VAH but suffers from severe bearish Cumulative Delta divergence. US100 rejected its POC and structural S/R from below but lacks room above near-term support. Gold, silver, euro, and bitcoin are all resting mid-channel within their ATR bands. Disciplined capital preservation warrants an all-HOLD stance until fresh liquidity unlocks during the London/NY overlap.

signals.rationale: During LONDON_SESSION, price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and closely pinned above POC 3896.98. The market is located below VWAP (3902.31) and below the EMA50 baseline (3900.57). CVD reads -2.24 with a BEARISH label and negative slope (-0.46), but the lack of volume confirmation (RVOL at 0.845, below the 2.0 threshold) prevents momentum continuation. Candles remain mid-channel within the ATR envelope (lower 3884.17, upper 3914.22) without testing outer bands. Price sits well above Session Low (3878.91) and S/R support (3887.45), while below Session High (3922.99). With price chopping at POC inside VA, disciplined risk management dictates HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish, price holding below falling VWAP (3902.31) and EMA50 (3900.57)

signals.rationale: In LONDON_SESSION, EURUSD trades inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10560 to VAH 1.10636) and right above POC 1.10598. Price is slightly above VWAP (1.10596) and essentially flat against the EMA50 baseline (1.10607). Cumulative Delta is +3,605 with a NEUTRAL label and a fading negative slope (-1978.25), indicating conflicting intraday order flow. RVOL is at 1.544, lacking the required > 2.0 yellow bar breakout interest. Candles are consolidating mid-channel between the ATR bounds (lower 1.10501, upper 1.10715). Price is boxed between support S/R 1.10574 / Session Low 1.10475 and resistance S/R 1.10662 / Session High 1.10726. The compression inside the Value Area warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral, price oscillating tightly around VWAP (1.10596)
signals.level_event: none, compressed between S/R 1.10574 and S/R 1.10662

signals.rationale: During LONDON_SESSION, GBPUSD is marginally above VAH (1.32378) and above POC 1.32349 (VAL 1.32271). Price holds above VWAP (1.32328) and above the EMA50 baseline (1.32348). However, CVD shows strong negative divergence at -2,921 with a BEARISH label and steep negative slope (-1291.67), directly disagreeing with the upside push. Crucially, RVOL is only 0.916, failing the RVOL > 2.0 breakout requirement and signaling a suspect move above VAH. The price is mid-to-upper channel within the ATR bands (lower 1.32210, upper 1.32459) and wicking against S/R 1.32391 and Session High 1.32431, well above Session Low 1.32209. Given the unconfirmed breakout and bearish delta divergence, the setup is suspect, demanding a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish, holding above VWAP (1.32328) and EMA50 (1.32348)
signals.level_event: rejection of Session High 1.32431 and S/R 1.32391

Inside the Value Area with minimal space to support, action is HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish, rejected below VWAP (28316.59) and EMA50 (28274.59)
